job.title: Health & Safety Consultants and Contractors - Partner with Zenergy
job.description:
Location: Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane 
Type: Contract / Interim 
Duration: 6 weeks to 12 months

Zenergy is growing its contractor and consultant network across Sydney, Melbourne and Brisbane. Site Safety Consultants, Safety Auditors and Systems and Safety-in-Design specialists with 3+ years' experience: partner with Australia's HSE specialists and work with Tier 1 clients from ASX-listed to multinational companies.

The opportunity
Our clients are some of Australia's largest employers: Tier 1 contractors, rail and infrastructure operators, national logistics businesses, manufacturers and ASX-listed corporates. They come to Zenergy when they need safety professionals who can walk on site, understand the risk profile and deliver from day one.

We currently have, and expect to keep having, assignments for:
  • Site Safety Consultants - own all aspects of site-based safety: inductions, risk assessments, SWMS review, contractor management, incident response and investigation, toolbox talks and client reporting
  • Safety Auditors - plan and deliver contractor, site and management-system audits, write findings that stand up to scrutiny and support corrective action
  • Systems and Safety-in-Design specialists - develop, review and embed safety management systems, procedures and design risk processes aligned to ISO 45001 and client requirements
About you
  • 3+ years in health and safety, with site-based experience
  • Cert IV, Diploma or Degree in WHS/OHS or related; lead auditor training highly regarded
  • Auditing experience against ISO 45001, client frameworks or regulatory requirements
  • Able to get up to speed quickly and manage safety independently on a new site
  • Excellent report writing and written communication
  • White Card, driver's licence and full Australian working rights
Why contractors partner with Zenergy
  • Secure, back-to-back work from a specialist Contract & Interim team
  • Assignments from 6 weeks to 12 months with global and leading local employers
  • Paid fortnightly
  • $600-$1,000 + super per day, depending on assignment and experience
  • A recruiter who speaks safety - we have placed HSE professionals for 20 years and run some of Australia's largest HSE recruitment programs
Apply
Apply via this listing, or contact our Contract & Interim team for a confidential conversation:
  • NSW / QLD - Matthew Owen, Contract Manager | 0480 004 970 | matthew.owen@zenergygroup.com.au
  • VIC / SA- Joanne Retallick, Contract Manager | 0482 076 255 | jo.retallick@zenergygroup.com.au

job.title: Group Health & Safety Manager ANZ
job.description:

Develop the group safety strategy and maintain its policies, standards and management systems. Lead assurance and critical control programs. Advise senior leaders on material risks, significant incidents and officer due diligence.

  • Ability to influence executives and operational leaders and lead geographically dispersed teams.

Shape how the organisation manages critical safety risks across Australia and New Zealand. Work directly with senior leaders and a collabarative ELT in a growing organisation. Offer strong, competitive remuneration. 

Submit your CV to Zenergy. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for a confidential discussion about the role and the recruitment process.

job.title: WHS Consultant - 6 Month contract
job.description:
Our client, a leading global organisation, is looking for a Health and Safety Coordinator to join its site safety team on a 6-month contract. The site is a large, fast-paced logistics and warehousing operation with a large workforce working across multiple shifts.
  
You'll work closely with operations leaders, team members and the wider safety team. Your job is to keep people safe, keep the site compliant and build a strong safety culture on the floor. This hands-on role suits someone who enjoys being out on site rather than behind a desk.
  
Key responsibilities:
  • Support the day-to-day running of the site's Work Health and Safety (WHS) management system
  • Carry out regular workplace inspections, safety walks and audits, and follow through on corrective actions
  • Lead or support incident investigations, including root cause analysis, and track actions to close-out
  • Complete and review risk assessments, JSAs/SWMS and hazard registers
  • Manage key operational risks, including manual handling, mobile plant and forklifts, traffic management, conveyors and racking
  • Deliver safety inductions, toolbox talks and training sessions for team members and contractors
  • Support injury management and return-to-work programs together with HR and injury management providers
  • Coordinate contractor safety, including permits to work and site access
  • Plan and run emergency preparedness activities, such as evacuation drills and first aid coverage
  • Maintain safety records and report on lead and lag indicators
  • Support Health and Safety Representatives (HSRs) and the site safety committee
  • Keep the site compliant with the WHS Act, WHS Regulations and relevant Codes of Practice
  • Coach and influence leaders and team members to build a proactive safety culture
About you:
  • Certificate IV in Work Health and Safety (minimum)
  • At least 3 years' experience in a WHS role in warehousing, logistics, distribution, manufacturing or a similar high-volume operational environment
  • Working knowledge of WHS legislation, regulations and Codes of Practice
  • Hands-on experience running incident investigations, risk assessments and workplace inspections
  • Strong communication skills and the confidence to influence people at every level, from team members to senior leaders
  • Good organisational skills, with the ability to manage several priorities in a fast-moving environment
  • Confident using Microsoft Office and incident or safety management systems
  • Comfortable working on the floor in a physically active environment, including walking long distances
  • Flexibility to support different shifts when needed
To be considered for this role please 'apply' by submitting an up to date word version of your CV. For more information please reach out to Matt at matthew.owen@zenergygroup.com.au

job.title: General Manager Health and Safety
job.description:
General Manager Health and Safety
Our client is a 100% Australian-owned, national technical and facilities services provider. With branches in every state and territory, they deliver essential maintenance and services across commercial, government, healthcare, education, mining and marine sectors.

About the role
You’ll lead health and safety across a dispersed, high-risk, field-based workforce, reporting to the COO. This is a new chapter for the function. The business is growing through acquisition, the safety agenda is being elevated, and you’ll have real freedom to shape what it looks like. You’ll take have seat at the table in the General Manager group and be a trusted partner to the Executive Leadership Team.

Key responsibilities
  • Spend around half your time in the field, travelling across multiple regions to see the true status of safety first-hand
  • Set and drive HSE strategy, targets and accountability, working with state-based General Managers to build genuine safety ownership
  • Introduce and embed a new management cycle where safety metrics are presented and owned by operational leaders
  • Challenge the frontline and bring safety to life, moving the business from compliance to commitment
  • Integrate safety culture as new companies join the group, demonstrating measurable improvement
  • Lead and develop a small HSE team, with scope to grow it as the business needs
About you
You will hold Senior HSE leadership experience in a multi-site, high-risk environment such as facilities management, maintenance, construction, utilities or technical service, with proven success leading change and safety culture transformation.

In addition you will display:
  • Strong working knowledge of Australian WHS legislation and officer due-diligence obligations
  • Presence and credibility, with the ability to engage everyone from technicians to executives (a little humour helps)
  • A strategic mindset, comfortable pivoting in a dynamic, agile environment
  • Relevant HSE tertiary qualifications and a current driver’s licence
What we offer
  • Salary of $300,000 to $330,000 plus short-term incentive
  • A visible, influential executive-level role with the full support of the leadership team
  • A direct, transparent and accountable leadership culture, led by a COO who is new to the business and building a team that is honest and takes ownership
  • The chance to design the function from the ground up
How to apply
For more information, please apply directly via the link with your resume. For additional inquiries, contact Jo Retallick at 0482 076 255

Thank you for your interest, we look forward to receiving your application!

Reporting to the Health and Safety Manager, you will provide hands-on safety support across a large-scale construction environment, working closely with project management, supervisors, subcontractors and frontline personnel.

You will support safety performance through site inspections, incident investigations, risk assessments, training and ongoing assurance activities, while promoting a positive and proactive safety culture.

  • Demonstrated experience in a Health and Safety Advisor, HSE Advisor, Safety Coordinator or similar position.

  • Permanent employment with a leading international infrastructure contractor.

Reporting to the H&S Manager, you will provide hands-on safety support across a geographically dispersed workforce, with a strong focus on operational engagement, injury management and continuous improvement.

Working closely with operational leaders and frontline personnel, you will support safety performance through workplace inspections, incident investigations, training, risk management and ongoing assurance activities.

This position will suit an experienced safety professional who enjoys being visible in the field, building strong relationships and taking ownership of a broad H&S remit across multiple locations.

Key Responsibilities
  • Provide visible, hands-on safety support across operational teams and field-based activities.
  • Build strong relationships with operational managers, supervisors and employees to promote a positive safety culture.
  • Coordinate workers' compensation claims, injury management and return-to-work programs.
  • Lead incident investigations, risk assessments and corrective action management.
  • Conduct workplace inspections, audits and safety observations across multiple locations.
  • Develop and deliver safety training, toolbox talks, inductions and safety communications.
  • Support the maintenance and continuous improvement of safety management systems and procedures.
  • Maintain safety reporting, compliance documentation and legislative requirements across multiple jurisdictions.
About You
  • Diploma or tertiary qualification in Work Health and Safety or equivalent.
  • Demonstrated experience in an H&S Advisor, Senior Advisor or Business Partner position.
  • Experience across infrastructure, utilities, engineering services, facilities management, manufacturing or other operational environments highly regarded.
  • Practical experience managing workers' compensation, injury management and return-to-work activities.
  • Strong capability in incident investigations, risk assessments, workplace inspections and audits.
  • Working knowledge of contemporary safety management systems and relevant ISO standards.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to influence personnel at all levels.
  • Comfortable working autonomously and travelling to operational sites as required.
  • Current Australian driver's licence and full Australian working rights.
What's on Offer
  • Competitive remuneration package, negotiable depending on experience.
  • Company vehicle, fuel and toll card included.
  • Sydney-based position with flexible working arrangements.
  • Broad operational safety responsibilities across a national organisation, with regular travel.
  • Opportunity to work closely with an experienced safety leader and contribute to ongoing operational improvements.
